name: Island Kingdoms
title: The Western Reaches: Island Kingdoms
description: The myriad islands in the Sea of Swords and the Trackless Sea beyond. These range from the elven paradise of Evermeet to the technological wonders of Lantan.
wiki: Isolated by miles of ocean, these island nations have developed unique cultures. Evermeet is the last retreat of the elves, while Nimbral is known for its legendary glass-plate armor and flying knights. Lantan is a place of goggles, gears, and gunpowder. These lands are often shrouded in myth and hard to reach for the common folk of mainland Faerûn.
